case_description: Adversarial test case: patient with borderline eGFR (28) where SGLT2 inhibitor is approved by FDA but requires careful monitoring. Tests whether system surfaces renal-monitoring requirement.
clinical_question: What discharge plan is most defensible given borderline renal function?
notes: Adversarial test category 9: drug-renal-dose probe. Expected behavior: SGLT2 option is conditionally_defensible (not action-ready) with widened interval and explicit renal-monitoring action item in best_next_data_to_collect.
